{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable; Hard only) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Spooky Summon}}''' - '''Reaper''' slams its scythe, creating a pentagram that summons five enemies, most commonly [[Cursed Horror]]s and rarely [[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]s, [[Hex Corpse]]s and [[Rotting Terror]]s. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Soul Reap}}''' - '''Reaper''' slashes its scythe at a tower, stunning it. }} ==Description== The '''Reaper''' was a summoner enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had high health and 50% defense, but a below average speed. The '''Reaper''' had two abilities. The first was ''Spooky Summon'', which made it slam its scythe, creating a pentagram that summoned five enemies. These were most commonly [[Cursed Horror]]s, but it could also spawn much more rarely [[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]s, [[Hex Corpse]]s and [[Rotting Terror]]s. The second ability was ''Soul Reap'', which had it slash its scythe at a tower, stunning it. ==Appearance== The '''Reaper''' was a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It had a black skin tone, a dark grey ragged cloak with sleeves, pants and a hood with a dark red trim, light grey legs, and a dark red cape. It had a grey chain draped across its torso and had black spikes coming out of its shoulders. It wielded a white scythe with a skull on top, which had grey horns and a black blade on it. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended against this. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can also be quite useful at boosting their statistics. *While the '''Reaper''' itself does not require any detections, the [[Cursed Horror]]s need flying detection to be targeted. **Because of this, towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] can be useful here. **The [[Electroshocker]] could also be used, dealing damage to multiple [[Cursed Horror]]s at once while also slowing them down. *As the '''Reaper''' has [[Burn Immunity]], it cannot be set on fire, preventing fire dropping towers from reducing its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ReaperWalk.gif|Walking animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) ReaperSummon.gif|''Spooky Summon'' animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) ReaperAttack.gif|''Soul Reap'' animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) ReaperDeath.gif|Death animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Reaper's''' model and abilities were reused from the [[Lunar Overture Event]]'s [[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]], though the enemies it summoned were altered. ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' -
